summary: Firefox improved scrolling, animation scheduling, touch events, and layout behavior across split and transformed content. It added structured remote-process type information, dispatched touch events once per distinct target, handled throttled animations more explicitly, and expanded anchor positioning to account for containing blocks, transforms, and fragmented elements. The work also removed legacy CSS `attr()` handling and old scrollbar code, improved image lifetime management, and made print-preview downloadable fonts load from files rather than inline `srcdoc` documents.
